title: Nourishing Cheesy Uruguayan Chicken Gratin
description: A resinous, cheese-pull Uruguayan dish featuring char-grilled chicken and a rich chicken stock.
instructions: Season the chicken breasts with salt and pepper, then set aside.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onions and cook until they start to caramelize, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the chicken breasts to the skillet and cook until browned on both sides, about 5-6 minutes.
Transfer the chicken breasts to a baking dish and pour in the chicken stock.
Bring the chicken stock to a simmer and cook until it has reduced by half, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the heavy cream and shredded cheddar cheese until the cheese is melted and the sauce is smooth.
Pour the cheese sauce over the chicken breasts and top with shredded parmesan cheese.
Transfer the baking dish to the preheated oven and bake until the cheese is golden brown and bubbly, about 15-20 minutes.
Remove the dish from the oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley before serving.
